prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Production anime animation WATER SPRITE ATLAS, transparent alpha. Input is style/light/perspective reference ONLY. Do not draw any glass, leaf, hands, table or environment. Exactly FOUR columns and TWO rows, EIGHT equally sized rectangular cells, no grid and no text. In EACH cell a PAIR of very narrow water films flows down the left and right outer walls of an INVISIBLE rounded wine goblet. All eight pairs share identical anchors, fixed gap between starts; the right side is shorter and delayed. Camera and curvature like the reference bowl. Each cell has extensive empty transparent margin. Sequential animation from top-left to bottom-right: 1 tiny thin meniscus lip at left top and smaller at right top, 2 lip bulges, left short uneven trickle forms, 3 left film extends halfway down invisible bowl with a ragged taper, right short trickle starts, 4 left film extends along bowl curvature and first bead bulges at its lower end; right trickle halfway, 5 both films flow with slightly wider folds and irregular thin bodies, left tip narrowed with hanging bead, 6 left bead detaches with gap while new bead forms and right film stretches, 7 films narrow and break in places with a few transparent gaps and reduced folds, 8 only short clinging wet traces, no free falling drops. Same water across frames with logical evolving shape, not duplicated frozen streams. Water is HAND DRAWN 2D CEL ANIME with thin desaturated brown-grey contours, restrained cream highlight patches and very pale transparent warm grey-green interiors. Flat 2-tone cel shading, thin crisp linework matching the reference, NO photorealistic shiny chrome, no bright silver rim, no glossy 3D, NO glow, NO bloom, no soft shadow around objects, no opaque white fill. True transparent alpha outside thin water contours; empty invisible goblet interior between streams. Do not draw connecting horizontal lines between the streams. No background.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: isolated transparent hand-painted 2D animation atlas of pigment gently DIFFUSING INSIDE WATER, no container. Exactly FOUR columns and TWO rows, eight aligned equal cells, no labels, no grid. Color: muted warm rose/terracotta like a drop of tea dye spreading underwater in a warm anime illustration. Soft edges WITHIN the small pigment body; completely transparent empty background outside. Each cell contains ONLY a subtle translucent pigment bloom with a common fixed rectangular registration area. First cell bottom-left tiny diluted wisp, second gently branching upward thin stream with a curling fine tendril, third two watery lobes slowly spreading toward the middle, fourth broader asymmetric feathery bloom with clear gaps, fifth wisps gently spread to the upper right with less empty space, sixth nearly fills the invisible rectangle but still has delicate uneven density, seventh diluted uniform tint across most of the rectangle with a few natural clear pockets, eighth softly uniform translucent dusty rose rectangular wash with completely transparent margins on all sides. Appearance of colored WATER diffusion, not smoke, not a cloud in air, not magical fire. No bubbles, particles, neon, shine, sparkles or 3D; no background, glass, hands, leaf, text, shadows or props. Keep all eight blooms the same muted pigment and same lighting, avoiding saturated red. Material will be used as an ALPHA MATTE inside the water of the reference illustration, so subtle internal density differences and clean transparent cell margins matter.

Use case: illustration-story. Production transparent micro-residue sprite atlas for a 2D cel-shaded anime water glass. The reference is style and warm lighting ONLY. Draw exactly 5 columns by 3 rows of individual separated TINY dull organic impurities, one sprite in each cell, centered with huge clear transparent margins, no text, labels or grid. These are five families, column 1 small irregular warm grey-brown rounded granule, column 2 thin ochre flake/chip with an asymmetrical broken edge, column 3 small dark olive organic crumb, column 4 a tiny bent tan plant fiber like a short tapered splinter, column 5 small pale beige porous sediment fleck. Each row has a different shape for the same five families, total FIFTEEN distinct but related sprites. Matte flat 2-tone cel shading, subtly dark brown contour, match warm anime painting. Not jewels, not crystals, not stones with faceted shiny edges, not glowing particles, not confetti, not leaves or emoji. No drop shadows. No water, glass, scene or background. Actual transparent alpha outside each little illustrated irregular sprite. Plenty of empty space separating every cell.
